notes.title: Early Access Demo v0.3
notes.content:
Changelog: 

[list]
[*] Added new mechanics related to crafting, you can now drag certain items over other items to craft them, for example dragging a knife over a chair leg will allow you to crafting a smoothed stick, which can be used as a handle. axe heads can be dragged onto this item. crafted from chairs or dropped from partygoers. More to be added soon!
[*] DO NOT let your sanity get too low, weird things will happen. You have been warned...
[*] Minor Bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Release v0.1
notes.content:
[h3]DEMO OUT NOW![/h3]

This is the first release out for the early supporters of our game! Thank you so much for being an awesome part of this experience with us, we proudly present our first playable version of WTTB!ːsteamthumbsupː

Changelog:

[list]
[*] Inventory system: open with I
[*] Skill menu: Open menu with J.
[*] Notification system
[*] 20+ Items / Weapons
[*] Fully improved the player health system
[*] Fixed most bugs related to saving and loading
[*] Improved Entity AI
[*] Added save deletion button (will be improved later)
[*] Reworked UI

[*] Added -̵͚̐-̶̧̼̭̠͖͓̦̙͒̒̃͘͝-̸̬̜͂-̴̝̘͍͍̹͑͊̊͆̋̌̄̒-̷̗̳̘̈́̾͗̀͛̆̒͊̐̉-̸̧̝̱͉̘͍̔̽̊͋̔͋͂͜-̷̺̤͍̀͗́̉̍̔̋́-̸̧̦̲̮̻͕͕̠͑͑̍-̷̨̣̣̑͗̈́-̵̞͇̞͑͆͊̇̾̄̒̕-̷̨̪͈͉̦̪͖̬͉͈͓̈̀̾̓͂͊͊̏-̴͕̜͐̄̓̚͠=̵̟̦̝̫͈̣̿͋͗̓́́=̵̧̙̖̏̒̃̑͂̐́͋͘͝͠ͅ=̶̨̹̝̗̻͚̼̮̙̔̈́̈́͗̂̀̅̕͠͝ͅͅ
[/list]




Cheers to a successful game launch everyone!
